March 4, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 13.93% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund sold 75,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 463,256 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $71.40 million, down from 538,256 at the end of the previous reported quarter. United States Steel & Carnegie Pension Fund who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $894.09 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.69% or $1.21   $176.21. About 38.45M shares traded or 8.44% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
